learned: 2026-10-15: no lab-results page (the FAQ says 'available upon request'), but the WordPress media library holds ~770 reports, COA-FNY-<STRAIN6>-<FORMAT>-<YYMMDD>.pdf. Lab: Smithers CTS.
notes: The filename's strain is a 6-letter code (ALPINE, ELDERF), not a name; the strain comes from the report's product line ('Alpine Strawberry - 1.0g (T PRO)').
Format codes: 1G, T1GP / T2GP (Traveler Pro), LT1GP, L1G.
